name: What is a punch list in construction?

mainEntity.name: What is a punch list in construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: A punch list is a document generated near the end of a construction project that lists items needing completion, correction, or repair before final payment and project close-out. It typically includes minor deficiencies, aesthetic issues, or incomplete tasks. For Maine Results, Inc., compiling a thorough punch list involves a joint walkthrough with the client to ensure all agreed-upon work meets expectations and quality standards before final handover.
acceptedAnswer.description: A punch list is a document listing items requiring completion or repair before a construction project's final close-out.
